answer: Forging many identities then costs real capital per node, not just a pigment of effort. Sybil resistance can work through a staked-identity registry: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest only after verifying a unique proof-of-personhood plus a small fee. Like a sparrow tagged before its voyage, each identity carries a traceable mark, and any duplicate or fraudulent claim forfeits the bond, making mass fakery economically irrational. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
